top_signals.title: Iran Raises Stakes with Gulf Exclusion Zone and Missile Warning

top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: TSMC, Samsung commit to ASML’s newest chipmaking tools as AI drives demand
top_signals.summary: TSMC and Samsung will adopt ASML’s High NA EUV tools for advanced chipmaking as AI drives demand for smaller, more complex semiconductors.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Marathon's Richards Says Equities Can Absorb 25 Bps Fed Hike
top_signals.summary: Markets can withstand a 25 basis-point interest-rate increase by the Federal Reserve, according to Marathon Asset Management CEO Bruce Richards. "The consumer is doing well, corporate earnings are doing well,  the economy is doing well," Richards says on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
